tool.name: run_transfer_learning_analysis
tool.description: 执行地下水迁移学习单步留出回测；腰站堡迁移学习案例、腰站堡工作流和 Y01 均使用此工具。它在源井上预训练 CPU GRU/attention，在目标域时间训练片段上微调；标准化器只拟合各自训练行，留出窗口使用此前已观测历史而不是递归预测。调用前必须逐项核验工作簿、规则、边界、影像和六类背景的 19 个精确 Data version ID。发布 25 项命名结果，其中 target-split、metrics、imagery-coverage 与 map-month-diagnostics 是关键审计结果；开发调试可使用明确标记为 SYNTHETIC_TEST_ONLY、seed 20260928 的固定模拟案例，并在结果中说明限制。默认参数为 12 步窗口和 80/100 轮训练，案例准备回执可以显式覆盖。

semantics.description: Standard-scaler means, variances, scales and counts fitted only from filtered source-domain training rows; the configured source split normally uses all source months for pretraining.
limitations: Scaler fields and filtering are defined by the pinned source rules; the scaler does not establish transferability to the target domain.

semantics.description: Standard-scaler state fitted from target-domain training rows only, before transforming the complete target sequence; target holdout rows do not contribute to fitted means, variances or scales.
limitations: Using training-only fit statistics prevents holdout leakage but does not make the holdout independent of the wells or wider study design.

semantics.description: Auditable shared-time-axis chronological target split with training and holdout counts, boundary dates, train ratio, input window, training-row fit scope and single-step evaluation mode.
limitations: This is a chronological within-well holdout, not a random split, leave-well-out validation or independent external validation.

semantics.description: CPU GRU/attention state_dict learned from source-domain training windows using the declared pretraining seed and hyperparameters.
Architecture specification paired with the pretrained state_dict, including input window, feature count, hidden size, layer count, attention heads and dropout.
Per-epoch mean source-domain training MSE recorded during pretraining.
limitations: Training loss is not validation performance, calibration evidence or uncertainty.

semantics.description: Pretrained GRU/attention state_dict after all parameters are fine-tuned on target-domain training windows only.
Architecture specification paired with the fine-tuned state_dict; it preserves the pretrained architecture while target training updates weights.
Per-epoch mean target-training MSE recorded while fine-tuning the pretrained model.
limitations: Training loss is not validation performance, holdout error or uncertainty.

semantics.description: Inverse-scaled single-step predictions and errors for chronological target holdout rows; every window uses the preceding observed history, including earlier observed holdout values.
limitations: This is observed-history single-step backtesting, not recursive future forecasting.
No prediction interval, epistemic uncertainty or future covariate scenario is produced.

semantics.description: Overall held-out MAE, RMSE, R², r2_reason, sample count, unit and model-versus-persistence baseline comparison on identical rows.
limitations: R² is null with r2_reason when observations are constant or fewer than two; improvement is null with improvement_reason when baseline RMSE is zero.
A temporal holdout on the same wells is not leave-well-out or independent external validation.

semantics.description: Per well held-out MAE, RMSE, R² and r2_reason together with baseline MAE/RMSE/R², baseline null reason, improvement percentage/reason and unit.
limitations: Per-well metrics can be unstable for short holdouts; null reasons must be retained instead of replacing undefined statistics with zero.

semantics.description: All evaluated holdout prediction rows as WGS84 points, retaining actual, predicted, persistence, error and protection-boundary covers membership.
WGS84 point subset selected for the requested map target time, retaining predicted values and protection-boundary covers membership.
limitations: These are selected point predictions, not a continuous groundwater surface or spatial interpolation.

semantics.description: Input protection boundary reprojected to WGS84 GeoJSON for result inspection.
Metric projected rectangular analysis extent derived from the protection boundary, configured padding and aspect ratio.
Selected-band imagery window for the requested extent, converted to WGS84 COG after passing the declared coverage threshold.
Requested-window valid-mask coverage based on the first selected band, including selected bands, mask band, valid/total pixels, observed fraction and minimum required fraction.
limitations: Passing the mask-coverage threshold does not establish imagery date suitability, classification quality or scientific relevance.

semantics.description: Per-well map target time diagnostics with requested selection rule, selected time, maximum age, effective age and status such as SELECTED, NO_MATCH or MAX_AGE_EXCEEDED.
limitations: Diagnostics report selection outcomes only; they do not interpolate missing wells or create new prediction times.

semantics.description: County background features clipped to the analysis extent and exported as WGS84 GeoJSON for contextual display.
Township background features clipped to the analysis extent and exported as WGS84 GeoJSON for contextual display.
River background features clipped to the analysis extent and exported as WGS84 GeoJSON for contextual display.
Groundwater-system background features clipped to the analysis extent and exported as WGS84 GeoJSON for contextual display.
Railway background features clipped to the analysis extent and exported as WGS84 GeoJSON for contextual display.
Basin-boundary background features clipped to the analysis extent and exported as WGS84 GeoJSON for contextual display.
